text: Toronto and East York Community Council will introduce bills.

July 8, 2026 Confirmatory Bills Toronto and East York Community Council passed Confirmatory Bill as By-law 778-2026, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006. July 9, 2026 General Bills Toronto and East York Community Council passed By-laws 779-2026 to 913-2026, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006. Confirmatory Bills Toronto and East York Community Council passed Confirmatory Bill as By-law 914-2026, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006.
